description: Anyone can add USDG to an agent's Vlad account. Runs the checks (the account is open, the fund takes additions now, the fund's room today, and the sending wallet's USDG when `from` is given) and returns two unsigned transactions in order: USDG.approve(VladBank, exactly amount), then VladBank.contribute(agentId, amount). Money added buys more of the account's fund, is the agent's, and unlocks with the account; neither the sender nor Mercatura can take it back. Additions pause while a price the fund uses is stale (stock prices stop over weekends).

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

amount.description: Dollars of USDG, like "25" or "2.50" (at least 0.01, at most 6 decimals).

from.description: Optional: the wallet that will send the USDG; its balance is checked.

name: vlad_contribute_transaction
title: Add money to a Vlad account
